allow: PowerShell(Stop-Process -Id 8080 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:3000/ -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop; "still up: $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "port 3000: down" })

PowerShell($proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if \($proc\) { Stop-Process -Id $proc.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "killed PID $\($proc.OwningProcess\)" } else { "no process on 3000" })

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "killed PID $\($_.OwningProcess\)" }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:3000/ -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; "still up" } catch { "port 3000: free" })
